mapper.select:
SELECT AA.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT TBI.CARRYIN_DATE
,ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN TBI.STOCK_WT > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS TOTAL_STOCK_CNT ,SUM(TBI.STOCK_CT) AS TOTAL_STOCK_SUM_CT ,SUM(TBI.STOCK_WT) AS TOTAL_STOCK_SUM_WT FROM TB_BMS_IN TBI WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_OUT TBO WITH (NOLOCK) ON TBO.IN_NO = TBI.IN_NO WHERE TBI.CARRYIN_DATE >= #{srchStartDate} AND TBI.CARRYIN_DATE <= #{srchEndDate} AND TBI.STOCK_CT > 0 AND TBI.STOCK_WT > 0
AND 1 = 0
GROUP BY TBI.CARRYIN_DATE
) AA

SELECT AA.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTAL_CNT FROM ( SELECT RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(HOUR, TXR.XRAY_TIME) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) AS XRAY_TIME ,COUNT(TXR.IN_PLAN_NO) AS XRAY_CNT ,COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TXR.INSPECTOR_ID, '')) AS XRAY_ID_CNT ,SUM(CASE WHEN TPP.INPUT_SCAN_TYPE = 'A' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS XRAY_ACNT ,SUM(CASE WHEN TPP.INPUT_SCAN_TYPE = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS XRAY_MCNT
,COUNT(TBI.IN_NO) AS TOTAL_IN_CNT ,SUM(TBI.CT) AS TOTAL_IN_SUM_CT ,SUM(TBI.WT) AS TOTAL_IN_SUM_WT FROM TB_BMS_IN TBI WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_OUT TBO WITH (NOLOCK) ON TBO.IN_NO = TBI.IN_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG TPP WITH(NOLOCK) ON TBI.IN_PLAN_NO = TPP.IN_PLAN_NO LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_XRAY_RESULT TXR WITH(NOLOCK) ON TBI.IN_PLAN_NO = TXR.IN_PLAN_NO WHERE TXR.XRAY_TIME >= CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat}) AND TXR.XRAY_TIME <= DATEADD(DAY, 1, CONVERT(CHAR(10), #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat})) AND TPP.INPUT_SCAN_TYPE IN ('A','M')
AND 1 = 0
GROUP BY RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(HOUR, TXR.XRAY_TIME) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2)
) AA
